target: Total daily unit sales across all stores and product families (sum of train.csv 'sales').
protocol: Chronological split, no shuffling. Hyperparameters chosen by rolling-origin CV inside the training period. Validation: model fit on the training period only. Test: untouched final period, model refit on training + validation. All models are scored on exactly the same dates and target. One-step-ahead rows use actual sales up to the previous day; the multi-step section forecasts recursively in 16-day blocks without any actuals after each block origin.

metric_definitions.wape: sum(|actual - predicted|) / sum(|actual|) * 100; null when sum(|actual|) = 0

baselines.historical_mean: mean daily sales of the fitting period

multistep_test.description: Rolling-origin recursive forecasts in blocks of 16 days over the test period; seasonal naive repeats the last observed week.

feature_importance.source: validation period, model fit on training period
